# DevOps Rollout Plan

Use this fallback skill for controlled deployment planning.

## Procedure
1. Define rollout phases and preflight checks.
2. Specify go/no-go criteria and verification signals.
3. Build rollback actions and ownership matrix.
4. Output communication and execution checklist.
